status: A/B plan established; W0 scope frozen; W1 identity implemented and covered; A-level acceptance open
scope: commerce consultation and human handoff workbench

quality_thresholds_proposed.latency_reporting: p50/p95 per task family, queueing and failures included
quality_thresholds_proposed.cost_reporting: success, failure, retry and unknown usage recorded separately

a_level_acceptance: an invited user signs in with their own account and sees only their workspace
one consultation completes against the live product ledger with openable sources
no evidence produces a clarification or handoff suggestion, never an invented answer
user confirmation leads to awaiting-approval, then to exactly one ticket
a separate approver credential is required; self-approval is refused
support claims and resolves a ticket with operator and timestamp recorded
a duplicate click or reconnect does not create a second ticket
a disabled or revoked identity is refused on the next request
the service starts, reports readiness and restores from a stated backup procedure
one real model completes the main path within frozen budgets
b_level_acceptance: two or more independent accounts complete the trial path unaided
two feedback rounds are classified and the confirmed defects are closed
quality metrics carry a denominator and a retained failure set
cost, latency and retry consumption are recorded for real runs
restart, pending-approval restart, same-path restore and stale-backup restore are rehearsed
a frozen candidate reruns the required gates in a clean environment
residual risks and implemented-versus-planned boundaries are written down
not_yet_evidence: synthetic catalogue and FAQ text are not authorised merchant data
the deterministic fixture model is not a real model result
a local SQLite ticket is not a merchant support-channel integration
framework test counts do not describe application business quality
no invited user has completed the path yet, so usability is unmeasured
